title: Pi
intro: The minimal coding agent, headless over --mode json. The platform's session id is Pi's session id, so continuation needs no state; thinking levels, MCP servers and stateless runs pass through.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek, two turns

notes: models.json is written every turn with one provider, hg, whose api follows the provider's shape (anthropic-messages by default).
MCP servers in the request's tools are written to .pi/mcp.json with exposure direct, so the agent sees them as tools.
store: false runs with --no-session; everything else opens the session named after the platform's.
